production.note: US model years. First: Kia America's 2023 EV6 specifications list a GT column, and its 13 December 2022 release says the 2023 EV6 GT goes on sale in Q4 2022 in limited quantities (kia-us-2023-ev6-gt-drive-release). Kia America's 2024 and 2025 EV6 specifications both list a GT column (kia-us-2024-ev6-specs, kia-us-2025-ev6-specs). Last: the 2026 EV6 specifications list only Light, Light Long Range, Wind and GT-Line (kia-us-2026-ev6-specs), and Motor1 (5 March 2026) quotes Kia: 'due to changing market conditions, the 2026 EV6 GT will be delayed until further notice' (motor1-2026-ev6-gt-delayed). Kia calls this a delay, not a cancellation; if the GT returns, the end year must be reopened.

body.note: Kia describes the EV6 as a crossover; crossovers are recorded as SUV.

configuration.note: 'a front-mounted 160kW motor, combined with a rear-mounted 270kW motor'

drivetrain.note: Drive type row: GT column 'AWD' (dual-motor e-AWD).

powerHp.note: 2023 model year. Quote: "Horsepower (hp) - AWD 320 hp 320 hp 576 hp" (columns Wind | GT-Line | GT) and "Horsepower (kw) - AWD 239 kw 239 kw 430 kW". Kia's release: "430 kW (576 hp) and 545 lb.-ft. of torque" (kia-us-2023-ev6-gt-drive-release). Same 576 hp for 2024 (kia-us-2024-ev6-specs). The facelifted 2025 GT is rated "601 hp" and "641 hp with Launch Mode" (478 kW) (kia-us-2025-ev6-specs); 576 hp covers two of the three US model years, so the launch rating is used.

weightLb.note: 2023 model year; one configuration (AWD). Quote: "Curb Weight, minimum (lbs.) - AWD 4,502 lbs. 4,502 lbs. 4,795 lbs." (columns Wind | GT-Line | GT). Same 4,795 lb for 2024 (kia-us-2024-ev6-specs). The 2025 GT is 4,883 lb (kia-us-2025-ev6-specs).
